items.title: Jackson interviewed by Monk Rowe, 2010
items.q: he’s a very, very good friend of mine

ctx.x: No. I know Cecil. It was written for a gentleman that I’ve known for quite some time, he’s a very, very good friend of mine and he’s just an avid jazz fan in general but he’s kind of my groupie, he’s followed me all over the world and I appreciate being around him. He’s got a great spirit about him and he’s a clinical psychologist so he just has so much information and wealth of things to share, and so that was written out of my relationship with him.
Oh. Well that’s a nice tribute to somebody, to have a tune.
